takeaway.en: Affection is a warm feeling; loving describes the care you show over time.
takeaway.zh: 爱意是心里的温暖感受；有爱则更强调持续表现出的关心。

takeaway.en: Relief follows a worry ending; joy can happen without an earlier worry.
takeaway.zh: 松一口气之前通常有过担心；喜悦却不一定来自担心的结束。

takeaway.en: Interest draws your attention; being absorbed means nearly all your attention stays there.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣会吸引你注意；全神贯注则是几乎把注意力都放在这件事上。

takeaway.en: Curiosity asks what is there; an adventurous spirit also wants to go and explore.
takeaway.zh: 好奇让你想弄明白；爱冒险还意味着愿意亲自去探索。

takeaway.en: Alert means noticing what is around you; anxious means feeling uneasy about what may happen.
takeaway.zh: 警觉是留心周围；焦虑是担心接下来可能出问题。

takeaway.en: Both express surprise; astonished usually emphasizes how hard the event is to believe.
takeaway.zh: 两者都表示惊讶；吃惊更突出事情让人难以相信。

takeaway.en: Amused is how something funny makes you feel; mirthful emphasizes lively laughter.
takeaway.zh: 被逗乐是觉得事情有趣；欢笑则更突出笑出来的样子。

takeaway.en: Animated describes lively expression; energetic emphasizes having plenty of energy.
takeaway.zh: 活泼地说话、比划是表现；精力充沛更强调身体有劲儿。

takeaway.en: Both involve thankfulness; appreciative also means noticing and valuing someone's effort.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能表示感谢；感激、欣赏也可以强调你看见了别人的付出。

takeaway.en: Both show strong interest; ardent often suggests an especially deep, lasting passion.
takeaway.zh: 两者都很有热情；ardent 更常突出热爱得深、持续得久。

takeaway.en: Both can follow an unexpected event; astonished highlights disbelief more than enjoyment.
takeaway.zh: 两者都可能因意外而出现；吃惊不一定表示你觉得这事好玩。

takeaway.en: Happy is broad; blissful describes an especially peaceful, deeply happy moment.
takeaway.zh: 开心可以发生在很多时候；幸福极了则多了一份安稳、满足。

takeaway.en: Breathing hard is a physical sign; excitement is a feeling. One does not prove the other.
takeaway.zh: 喘气急是身体反应；兴奋是情绪。前者不一定意味着后者。

takeaway.en: Hopeful looks toward what may go well; buoyant also describes a light, lifted mood now.
takeaway.zh: 希望是想着未来可能变好；心情愉快也强调此刻的轻快。

takeaway.en: Both can feel steady; peaceful often adds a deeper sense of safety and quiet.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能让人安定；平和常常还带着更深的安心与宁静。

takeaway.en: Relaxed means tension has eased; carefree means you are not thinking much about troubles.
takeaway.zh: 放松是紧绷感少了；无忧无虑是暂时不用操心烦恼。

takeaway.en: Happy names a feeling; cheerful often shows in a bright, friendly manner.
takeaway.zh: 快乐是心里的感受；高兴活泼还常常能从言谈举止中看出来。

takeaway.en: Comfortable means feeling at ease; secure places special emphasis on feeling safe.
takeaway.zh: 舒服是身体或处境自在；安心更强调觉得安全、可靠。

takeaway.en: Confidence says you can try; complacency may make you overlook what still needs practice.
takeaway.zh: 自信让你愿意尝试；自满可能让你忽略还需要练习的地方。

takeaway.en: Calm describes steadiness; composed means keeping that steadiness even during pressure.
takeaway.zh: 平静是心情安定；镇定更强调遇到挑战时仍能稳住自己。

takeaway.en: One use of concerned shows care for someone; another means worry that something may be wrong.
takeaway.zh: 关切可以是主动关心别人；担忧则是怕某件重要的事出问题。

takeaway.en: Confident looks toward what you can try; proud looks back at effort or progress you value.
takeaway.zh: 自信是相信自己能试一试；骄傲则多是为已经付出的努力或进步高兴。

takeaway.en: Both mean feeling pleased; contented often means being at ease with life as it is.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能表示满意；知足更突出对眼前生活感到安心满足。

takeaway.en: Curiosity wants to find out something unknown; interest can also be about something familiar.
takeaway.zh: 好奇是想弄明白未知的事；感兴趣也可以是喜欢已经熟悉的事。

takeaway.en: Dazzled emphasizes how a bright sight affects your senses; amazed describes a feeling of wonder.
takeaway.zh: 眼花缭乱强调画面让眼睛忙不过来；惊叹则是心里的感受。

takeaway.en: Both mean feeling happy; delighted usually sounds brighter and stronger than quietly pleased.
takeaway.zh: 两者都表示高兴；delighted 往往比 quietly pleased 更欢欣。

takeaway.en: Eager means wanting to start soon; expectant means waiting for something to happen.
takeaway.zh: 渴望是很想快点开始；期待是等着一件事发生。

takeaway.en: Both are happy moods; ebullient shows much more energy that seems to bubble over.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能形容好心情；热情洋溢更像快乐快要冒出来。

takeaway.en: Joy can be quiet or strong; ecstatic describes an exceptionally intense burst of happiness.
takeaway.zh: 喜悦可以安静也可以强烈；狂喜强调特别强烈的开心。

takeaway.en: Both look lively; effervescent especially suggests bubbly cheerfulness that spreads to others.
takeaway.zh: 两者都显得活泼；活力满满还带着能感染他人的欢快。

takeaway.en: Happy is general; elated often follows especially good news and feels uplifting.
takeaway.zh: 开心是广泛的感受；兴奋雀跃常来自特别好的消息。

takeaway.en: Both hold your attention; enchanted adds a sense of beauty or near-magic.
takeaway.zh: 两者都让人看得入迷；被迷住还带着美得像魔法一样的感觉。

takeaway.en: Being encouraged means support helped you keep going; confidence is belief in your ability.
takeaway.zh: 受到鼓舞强调支持给了你力量；自信是相信自己有能力尝试。

takeaway.en: Energetic means having energy; invigorated says something has refreshed that energy.
takeaway.zh: 精力充沛是有劲儿；精神焕发更强调休息或活动后重新有了劲儿。

takeaway.en: Both involve deep attention; engrossed emphasizes how an interesting task holds you.
takeaway.zh: 两者都指注意力很集中；沉浸其中更强调活动本身牢牢吸引你。

takeaway.en: You feel enlivened when something lifts your energy; animated describes how lively you look when you talk or move.
takeaway.zh: 感到活跃是某件事让你重新有了精神；活泼是你说话、动作中表现出的样子。

takeaway.en: Interest means wanting to know more; enthusiasm adds energy and eagerness to take part.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣是想了解；有热情还意味着想积极参与。

takeaway.en: Expectant focuses on waiting; excited adds lively energy about what may happen.
takeaway.zh: 期待主要是等待；兴奋还多了一股按捺不住的劲儿。

takeaway.en: Both feel exciting; exhilarated often follows an exciting experience and leaves you energized.
takeaway.zh: 两者都很激动；兴奋得精神焕发常是经历了刺激的事之后。

takeaway.en: Friendly means treating people kindly; expansive means feeling especially open and talkative.
takeaway.zh: 友好是待人亲切；开朗健谈则是此刻特别愿意和人交流。

takeaway.en: Hopeful means believing a good result is possible; expectant means waiting for the event to arrive.
takeaway.zh: 充满希望是相信可能有好结果；期待是等着事情到来。

takeaway.en: Both celebrate success; exultant highlights a sense of triumph, while jubilant highlights cheering.
takeaway.zh: 两者都可能因成功而快乐；exultant 更突出胜利感，jubilant 更突出欢呼。

takeaway.en: Curiosity sparks a question; fascination keeps your attention there for longer.
takeaway.zh: 好奇让你开始提问；着迷让你想继续看、继续了解。

takeaway.en: Feeling free emphasizes having choices; carefree emphasizes not being weighed down by worries.
takeaway.zh: 自由是有选择和行动的空间；无忧无虑是暂时没被烦恼压住。

takeaway.en: Being friendly means welcoming others; being loving expresses closer, ongoing care.
takeaway.zh: 友好是愿意善待他人；有爱更强调持续、亲近的关怀。

takeaway.en: Satisfied means a result seems good enough; fulfilled adds a sense of deeper meaning or completion.
takeaway.zh: 满意是结果符合期待；充实满足还包含重要事情做成后的意义感。

takeaway.en: Glad may mean simply happy; relief especially means an earlier worry has eased.
takeaway.zh: 高兴可以因为很多事；松一口气通常因为先前的担心消失了。

takeaway.en: Both are lively and cheerful; gleeful may add a playful, mischievous spark.
takeaway.zh: 两者都很快乐；gleeful 还可能带一点顽皮的得意。

takeaway.en: Glorious often describes how splendid something is; proud describes a person's feeling about achievement.
takeaway.zh: glorious 多用来形容事物很精彩；骄傲则是人对努力和成果的感受。

takeaway.en: Both describe happiness you can see; radiant emphasizes how strongly that warmth shows.
takeaway.zh: 两者都可以说人看起来很开心；神采飞扬更突出喜悦仿佛写在脸上。

takeaway.en: Cheerful is a happy mood; good-humored also means responding kindly when small things go wrong.
takeaway.zh: 高兴是一种心情；好脾气还强调遇到小麻烦也能温和地笑一笑。

takeaway.en: Grateful focuses on receiving kindness; appreciative also notices the worth of what someone did.
takeaway.zh: 感恩聚焦得到的帮助；感激与欣赏也会注意别人的付出有多珍贵。

takeaway.en: Gratified means pleased that something turned out well; proud emphasizes your own valued effort or progress.
takeaway.zh: 欣慰是看到结果不错；骄傲更突出自己重视的努力或进步。

takeaway.en: Happy covers many pleasant moments; joy often feels especially strong or meaningful.
takeaway.zh: 快乐包含很多舒服开心的时刻；喜悦常更强烈或更有意义。

takeaway.en: Helpful describes an action that assists; concern describes noticing and caring about a need.
takeaway.zh: 有帮助描述做了什么；关切强调你看见别人需要关心。

takeaway.en: Hopeful can concern one particular outcome; optimistic is a broader habit of expecting good things.
takeaway.zh: 希望可以是对某件事的期待；乐观是较稳定地相信事情可能变好。

takeaway.en: Both ask questions; inquisitive often describes someone who keeps asking and investigating.
takeaway.zh: 两者都爱提问；求知欲强还强调经常追问、继续研究。

takeaway.en: Inspired sparks a new idea or wish to create; encouraged makes you feel able to keep going.
takeaway.zh: 受到启发会冒出新点子；受到鼓舞是更有勇气继续做。

takeaway.en: Intense describes how strong a feeling is; excited names one particular kind of feeling.
takeaway.zh: 强烈说的是感受的程度；兴奋才是一种具体的感受。

takeaway.en: Interest means wanting to know or do more; curiosity often centers on an unknown question.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣是愿意了解或参与；好奇常围绕还不知道的答案。

takeaway.en: Interested means paying attention; intrigued means a mystery or unusual detail pulls you in.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣是愿意注意；被吸引常因一件稀奇或神秘的事。

takeaway.en: Refreshed means rested and renewed; invigorated adds a feeling of energy to act.
takeaway.zh: 神清气爽是休息后恢复精神；精力充沛则更突出想动起来的劲儿。

takeaway.en: Interested can mean watching from the side; involved means joining an activity.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣可以只是旁观；参与则是真的加入其中。

takeaway.en: Both mean happiness; joyous often colors an event or occasion with shared celebration.
takeaway.zh: 两者都指快乐；欢庆的喜悦常伴着特别的日子或庆祝活动。

takeaway.en: Jubilant highlights loud celebration; exultant emphasizes feeling victorious.
takeaway.zh: 欢欣雀跃突出忍不住欢呼；狂喜于成功更强调胜利感。

takeaway.en: Nervous means feeling tense; keyed-up adds being unusually wound up and ready to act.
takeaway.zh: 紧张是心里绷着；keyed-up 还强调身体和精神都处于高度准备状态。

takeaway.en: Loving describes showing care; affection describes the warm feeling underneath.
takeaway.zh: 有爱强调关心的表现；爱意强调心里那份温柔。

takeaway.en: Both can be gentle; mellow adds a soft, unhurried quality to the mood.
takeaway.zh: 两者都可能很放松；mellow 还强调柔和、不急不躁。

takeaway.en: Both are cheerful; merry often suggests laughing or celebrating together.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能让人高兴；merry 常带着欢笑和庆祝的气氛。

takeaway.en: Amused is being entertained; mirthful emphasizes the laughter that follows.
takeaway.zh: 觉得好笑是被逗乐；欢笑则更强调笑出来的快乐。

takeaway.en: Both mean being emotionally touched; moved can follow kindness, beauty, or something deeply meaningful.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能表示感动；moved 也可能来自美丽或有意义的事。

takeaway.en: Optimistic often describes a habit of expecting good; hopeful may concern one particular wish.
takeaway.zh: 乐观往往是平时看事的态度；有希望可以只针对某件事。

takeaway.en: Joy names happiness; overjoyed means that happiness feels exceptionally strong.
takeaway.zh: 喜悦是开心的感受；欣喜若狂则是开心得特别强烈。

takeaway.en: Thrilled is strong excitement; overwhelmed means there may be too much feeling to process at once.
takeaway.zh: 激动是强烈的兴奋；惊喜得不知所措则可能一时承受不了那么多感受。

takeaway.en: Calm means not stirred up; peaceful often adds a sense of inner safety and ease.
takeaway.zh: 平静是不慌不乱；平和还常常带着心里安心、舒展的感觉。

takeaway.en: Energetic means having energy; perky adds a cheerful, ready-to-go manner.
takeaway.zh: 精力充沛是有力气；精神活泼还带着开心、跃跃欲试。

takeaway.en: Pleasant often describes an experience; happy describes how a person feels.
takeaway.zh: pleasant 通常形容事情令人舒服；快乐说的是人的心情。

takeaway.en: Pleased is often quiet satisfaction; delighted usually expresses more visible delight.
takeaway.zh: 满意高兴可以是轻轻一笑；delighted 往往更喜形于色。

takeaway.en: Pride looks at something you value accomplishing; confidence helps you face what comes next.
takeaway.zh: 骄傲是珍惜已有的成果；自信帮助你面对接下来要做的事。

takeaway.en: Quiet describes how much sound someone makes; peaceful describes how they feel inside.
takeaway.zh: 安静是声音少；平和是心里的状态。安静的人也可能不开心。

takeaway.en: Both can describe visible happiness; radiant suggests it shines out unmistakably.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能说开心写在脸上；神采飞扬更突出那份明亮。

takeaway.en: Both describe exceptionally strong happiness; rapturous often sounds like being carried away by delight.
takeaway.zh: 两者都表示特别高兴；欣喜若狂更强调快乐让人情不自禁。

takeaway.en: Tired means needing rest; refreshed means rest has helped you recover.
takeaway.zh: 疲倦时需要休息；休息后神清气爽，说明精神恢复了一些。

takeaway.en: Calm is mental steadiness; relaxed also includes having less tension in your body.
takeaway.zh: 平静更强调心里安定；放松也包括身体不再绷紧。

takeaway.en: Satisfied can follow one result; contented often means feeling at ease with what you have.
takeaway.zh: 满意可以针对某个结果；知足更常是对眼前生活感到满足。

takeaway.en: Comfortable means at ease; secure means you especially trust that you are safe.
takeaway.zh: 舒服是感到自在；安心更强调相信自己受到保护。

takeaway.en: Sensitive means noticing or feeling things strongly; tender means responding with gentleness and care.
takeaway.zh: 感受细腻是容易察觉和被触动；温柔则是带着关心对待别人。

takeaway.en: Serene is a particularly deep, undisturbed kind of calm.
takeaway.zh: 宁静是一种更深、更不容易被打扰的平静。

takeaway.en: Fascinated means wanting to keep learning; spellbound suggests being so captivated you forget your surroundings.
takeaway.zh: 着迷是想继续了解；看得出神则像暂时忘了身边的事。

takeaway.en: Splendid praises something excellent; delighted describes a person's joyful reaction.
takeaway.zh: splendid 是夸事物很精彩；delighted 才是人高兴的感受。

takeaway.en: Interested is wanting to know more; stimulated means something has awakened your attention or senses.
takeaway.zh: 感兴趣是想继续了解；受到刺激是外界的事让你精神或感官活跃起来。

takeaway.en: Surprise is about not expecting something; welcome and unwelcome surprises can feel very different.
takeaway.zh: 惊讶来自出乎意料；惊喜和不愉快的意外，感受却可能很不同。

takeaway.en: Tender describes gentle care in action or feeling; affection is the warmth you feel toward someone.
takeaway.zh: 温柔是待人的轻柔；爱意是心里想关心对方的温暖。

takeaway.en: These two often mean nearly the same thing; thankful can sound especially natural after a particular helpful moment.
takeaway.zh: 两者都能表示感谢；thankful 常用在具体得到了帮助之后。

takeaway.en: Both are excited; thrilled emphasizes unusually intense happiness about something special.
takeaway.zh: 两者都兴奋；thrilled 更突出某件特别的事让人激动不已。

takeaway.en: Being touched means kindness has moved you; gratitude focuses on valuing the help itself.
takeaway.zh: 被感动是好意打动了你；感激更强调珍惜对方的帮助。

takeaway.en: Both are peaceful; tranquil often describes a quiet setting as well as the feeling it brings.
takeaway.zh: 两者都很宁静；tranquil 也常用来形容安静的环境。

takeaway.en: Trusting means relying on a person; secure means feeling safe in a situation.
takeaway.zh: 信任是觉得某个人可靠；安心是觉得自己的处境安全。

takeaway.en: Hopeful expects something good; upbeat adds a cheerful way of facing the moment.
takeaway.zh: 希望是觉得可能有好结果；乐观开朗还包括此刻的好心情。

takeaway.en: Warm can mean body temperature or closeness; affection specifically means caring about someone.
takeaway.zh: 温暖可以是身体有温度，也可以是心里亲近；爱意则专指关心他人的感受。

takeaway.en: Wide-awake means not sleepy; alert adds noticing what may need your attention.
takeaway.zh: 清醒是不困；警觉还表示留心周围可能发生的事。

takeaway.en: Wonderful describes something especially good; happy describes a person's pleasant feeling.
takeaway.zh: 精彩是在形容人或事物很棒；快乐是在描述人的感受。

takeaway.en: Both show enthusiasm; zestful emphasizes abundant lively energy.
takeaway.zh: 两者都很有热情；充满活力还更强调那股生机勃勃的劲儿。
